title: Storybook
description: A book for the Sophia reader: its settings, treasures and pages. Book 2's data in js/books/mermaid-city.story.js follows this shape.

short.description: Short title for the top bar and the book switcher

frame.description: Default illustration frame for every page

sketch.description: Draw SVG scenes through the hand-inked #sketch-filter

frame.description: vignette: soft painted edge on all sides (default). oval: storybook cameo. torn: full width, ragged bottom edge. bleed: plain edge-to-edge.

desc.description: Shown in the treasure bag once found

illustration.description: A full-frame painted or drawn picture file. It sits under any SVG `scene`, so a scene can add animated bits on top of a painting.

src.description: PNG, JPEG or SVG file, relative to index.html, e.g. img/mermaid-city/kelp.png

webp.description: Optional smaller WebP version; browsers that support it load this instead

alt.description: Used when the page has no `alt` of its own

width.description: Pixel size of the file (prevents layout jumps)

focus.description: Which part stays in view when the picture is cropped (CSS object-position)

scene.description: Key of an SVG scene drawn in the book's .js file

focus.description: For a painting found at img/<book>/<page>.*: which part stays in view when it's cropped (CSS object-position, e.g. "50% 20%" keeps the top)

sketch.description: Turn the hand-inked filter off for this page's SVG scene

fx.description: Animated canvas effect over the picture

pickup.description: A treasure to tap in the picture. x/y are in the 800 x 500 picture box.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for screen readers

text.description: One string per paragraph. Markup: {name} {sfx:sound|LABEL} {say:…} {pip:…} {shout:…} {huge:…} {whisper:…} {b:…}, or a paragraph of just {divider}.
